name: Inu to Onna no Ko
source:
Jacky, you're such a naughty puppy!

The protagonist indulges dirty thoughts, flirts with young girls, and glimpses at panties to his heart's content. All thanks to his accomplice!

Let's take another ecchi walk! ;)
